_comment: Shared $defs, merged into each stage schema's own $defs by scripts/run_stage.py before the API call (OpenAI Structured Outputs does not resolve external-file $ref, only in-document #/$defs/... pointers). Missingness codes and observability classes here must stay byte-identical to reference/DATA_DICTIONARY_v3.md — do not invent new vocabulary here.

MissingnessCode.description: 1=explicitly present, 0=explicitly absent, NA=not applicable, UNK=unknown/insufficient information, NOE=not observable from legal text alone, EXT=requires external evidence. Never blank.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotation from the supplied legal-context package. Required (non-null) unless value is an abstention code (UNK/NOE/EXT), in which case null is allowed but abstention_reason on the parent object must be filled instead.

CategoricalValue.description: For free-text/enum fields (e.g. regulatory_level, mode_of_operation). The specific allowed_values for a given field are enforced post-hoc by run_stage.py against reference/DATA_DICTIONARY_v3.md, not by this generic schema.

TestCondition.description: One of the five relational-test conditions from reference/RIT_CODEBOOK_v3.md, answered independently before any final verdict.

ContextEscapeHatch.description: Structured request for one additional piece of legal context, in lieu of filling a gap from parametric/training knowledge. Resolved at most once per unit per stage by scripts/context_request_loop.py.
